release_kind: Per-skill selection of already evaluated package snapshots; not wholesale adoption of candidate-v2.

khorikov-unit-testing.basis: Two blind attempts found no unjustified scenarios for candidate versus one shipping scenario in each baseline answer. Required fixed protection and healthy original tests retained. Extra protection was mixed; no general dominance claimed.

requirements-tdd.basis: Initial candidate removed one redundant cap example. Directed blind judge preferred candidate in C04: eight fixed faults detected, and an additional positive discount rounding to zero exposed a meaningful negative-cap gap missed by baseline. No forced Cartesian expansion.

test-quality-review.basis: Requested guidance for economy and bounded automated mutation/report interpretation; both blind attempts preserved healthy domain/API boundaries and correctly treated the equivalent mutant and infrastructure statuses. Behavioral comparison tied; no superiority claim for this skill.

state-machine-verification.basis: No demonstrated economy gain in initial comparisons; candidate introduced an exact-type caveat. In directed comparison baseline detected eight workflow faults; candidate seven, missing numeric boolean returns. Both accepted original refactor and subclass diagnostic. Keep previously installed package unchanged.

overall_limit: Initial R1 tie and R2 inconclusive. Directed overall preference was baseline, with separate TDD advantage for candidate. Results are exploratory, not pooled or statistical. No new all-skills model run of the selected composition; each released package is byte-identical to its evaluated snapshot and tasks used one leading skill.
